archetypes.name: dyn-contract-prose
archetypes.rationale: Prompt contract wording changed across shared and skill surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design notification wording for consistency across AGENTS.md, orchestrator-never.md, design-background-wait.md, and skills/design/SKILL.md. Focus on whether empty-output, prefix-identical repeat, and new non-empty notification paths are ordered and non-conflicting. Check that Step 3 and Step 5c sentinel names stay distinct. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
